correctness.rationale: On C_n each upward-closed valuation is U_k={k,...,n-1}. If row R(t) has min ell_t=n for empty and max h_t=-1 for empty, then existential-row predicate on U_k iff h_t>=k and universal-row predicate iff ell_t>=k, including empty rows. The four Balbiani–Gencer modal clauses reduce exactly to thresholds P_i=max_{t<=i}h_t, Q_i=min_{t>=i}ell_t,D_i=min_{t>=i}h_t,E_i=max_{t<=i}ell_t. Hence equal signature iff all modal operations (and by structural induction all formulas with implication/coimplication) are pointwise indistinguishable under common valuations. Prefix/suffix recurrence constrains each row (ell_i,h_i) independently to an explicit finite local choice set A_i(s); each nonempty row endpoint pair admits 2^{h-ell-1} interior choices, proving exact multiplicative fiber formula. Remove interior edges for at most two per world; a prescribed ladder of rows forces both extremes each row for every equivalent relation, giving sharp 2n when n>=2. Explicit n=2 pairs show each operator irreducible. Independent exhaustive enumeration of all 2^{n^2} binary relations for n<=4 reproduces class counts (2,16,279,7171) and largest fibers (1,1,8,324); universal result follows threshold algebra, not these finite checks.
